wallet_activityExportDismissed.en: CSV created, but no share destination was chosen
wallet_activityExportDismissed.zh: 已生成 CSV，但没有选择分享去处

wallet_activityExportEmpty.en: No records in this range to export
wallet_activityExportEmpty.zh: 这一段没有记录可以导出

wallet_activityExportFailed.en: Export didn't finish; nothing left this device
wallet_activityExportFailed.zh: 导出没有完成，没有任何内容离开这台设备

wallet_activityExportShared.en: Records exported. Choose a destination in the share sheet
wallet_activityExportShared.zh: 记录已导出，请在分享面板中选择去处

wallet_activityExportUnavailable.en: System sharing isn't set up in this session; nothing was exported
wallet_activityExportUnavailable.zh: 本次运行没有装配系统分享，没有导出任何内容

wallet_approvalScreensApprovalGuardFolio.en: Token, spender, amount and the decoded call are shown in full before signing.
wallet_approvalScreensApprovalGuardFolio.zh: 代币、Spender、额度与解码后的调用在签名前完整显示。

wallet_approvalScreensApprovalGuardSignL.zh: 事实已过期 · 重新准备

wallet_approvalScreensApprovalGuardUnlim.en: You've confirmed twice. Once signed, this spender can keep using this token's entire balance, and the permission stays valid after you leave their interface until you revoke it in Token approvals.
wallet_approvalScreensApprovalGuardUnlim.zh: 你已二次确认。签名后该 Spender 可持续动用这个代币的全部余额，离开对方界面后权限依然有效，直到你在授权盘点里回收。
这是一次无限额度授权

wallet_approvalScreensApprovalGuardUnlim.en: A contract with an unlimited allowance can move this token's entire balance at any time until you revoke it. LOOP's default is to approve only the amount needed this time.
wallet_approvalScreensApprovalGuardUnlim.zh: 获得无限额度的合约可以在任何时间转走这个代币的全部余额，直到你主动回收。LOOP 的默认是只授权本次需要的额度。

wallet_approvalScreensApprovalGuardUnlim.en: Unlimited approval means ongoing access to your entire balance
wallet_approvalScreensApprovalGuardUnlim.zh: 无限授权意味着持续动用全部余额

wallet_approvalScreensApprovalsCapabilit.en: Token approvals aren't available right now

wallet_approvalScreensApprovalsFreshness.en: Approvals since block {groupedFigure} · Indexed {groupedFigure2} / head {groupedFigure3} · observed {relativeTime}
wallet_approvalScreensApprovalsFreshness.zh: 授权记录自区块 {groupedFigure} 起 · 索引高度 {groupedFigure2} / 链头 {groupedFigure3} · 观察于 {relativeTime}

wallet_approvalScreensApprovalsPageBlock.en: The approval list isn't available right now

wallet_approvalScreensConfirmUnlimited.en: An unlimited allowance doesn't expire over time or when this transaction ends. This spender can later move this token's entire balance without asking you again. It's only taken back when you send approve(spender, 0) from Token approvals.
wallet_approvalScreensConfirmUnlimited.zh: 无限额度不会随时间或这笔交易结束而失效。该 Spender 之后可以在不再询问你的情况下转走这个代币的全部余额。只有你在授权盘点里发送一笔 approve(spender, 0) 才会收回。

wallet_approvalScreensEmptyMessage.en: This wallet has no active approvals
wallet_approvalScreensEmptyMessage.zh: 这个钱包没有有效授权

wallet_approvalScreensMessage.en: Batch revoke isn't available yet. Each revoke is a separate signature.
wallet_approvalScreensMessage.zh: 批量回收还没有开放。每一笔回收都是一次单独的签名。

wallet_approvalScreensText.en: Approve only the amount this transaction needs.
wallet_approvalScreensText.zh: 只授权本次交易需要的额度。

wallet_deferredScreensBody.en: A scan result never starts signing directly; amount, network and recipient are shown again.
wallet_deferredScreensBody.zh: 识别结果不会直接发起签名；金额、网络与收款方会再次展示。

wallet_deferredScreensBody2.en: Choose the source chain, destination chain and amount first; then estimated fees and arrival time are shown.
wallet_deferredScreensBody2.zh: 先选来源链、目标链与数量，再显示预计费用和到账时间。

wallet_deferredScreensBody3.en: Source chain confirmation, bridging and destination arrival are three separate states.
wallet_deferredScreensBody3.zh: 源链确认、桥接中和目标链到账是三个独立状态。

wallet_deferredScreensBody4.en: The check runs entirely on this device: it won't open this URL, follow redirects or connect a wallet.
wallet_deferredScreensBody4.zh: 核对完全在本机完成：不会打开这个网址，不会跟随跳转，也不会连接钱包。

wallet_deferredScreensBridgeScopeNoticeB.en: Bridge fees, received amount and estimated time can only come from a real route. Without a route there are no such numbers, and this page won't substitute sample data.
wallet_deferredScreensBridgeScopeNoticeB.zh: 跨链费、到账数量与预计时间只能由真实路由给出。没有路由就没有这些数字，这一页不会用示例数据代替它们。

wallet_deferredScreensBridgeScopeNoticeT.zh: 这里不会出现预估数字

wallet_deferredScreensBridgeStatusLeaveN.en: Once Bridge is available, it continues in the background, notifies you when done, and can be viewed in transaction history.
wallet_deferredScreensBridgeStatusLeaveN.zh: 跨链开放后会在后台继续，完成后推送通知，也可以从交易历史查看。

wallet_deferredScreensDappConfusableNoti.en: It looks like {confusableReading}, but it contains look-alike characters that aren't Latin letters. This is the most common phishing trick, so it was blocked.
wallet_deferredScreensDappConfusableNoti.zh: 它看起来像 {confusableReading}，但其中有不是拉丁字母的同形字符。这是最常见的钓鱼手法，已阻止。

wallet_deferredScreensDappConfusableNoti.en: This domain is impersonating another domain
wallet_deferredScreensDappConfusableNoti.zh: 这个域名在冒充另一个域名

wallet_deferredScreensDappExecutionUnava.en: Wallet connection and signing aren't available yet
wallet_deferredScreensDappExecutionUnava.zh: 连接钱包与签名尚未开放

wallet_deferredScreensDappFindingsEmptyM.en: This only means the address itself is well-formed; it doesn't mean the site is trustworthy.
wallet_deferredScreensDappFindingsEmptyM.zh: 这只说明地址本身规范；它不代表这个站点可信。

wallet_deferredScreensDappNoFetchNoticeB.en: The check is purely local: no requests, no DNS lookups and no redirects, so the domain you see is exactly the one you typed.
wallet_deferredScreensDappNoFetchNoticeB.zh: 核对是纯本地计算：没有请求、没有 DNS 解析，也不会跟随任何跳转，所以你看到的域名一定是你输入的那个。

wallet_deferredScreensDappNoFetchNoticeT.en: This page won't open the URL

wallet_deferredScreensDappOmniboxHintTex.en: Search assets / communities / users / Launch / DApps / URLs
wallet_deferredScreensDappOmniboxHintTex.zh: 搜索资产 / 社区 / 用户 / Launch / DApp / 网址

wallet_deferredScreensDappReviewEmptyMes.en: Enter a URL to see the normalized result and any issues here.
wallet_deferredScreensDappReviewEmptyMes.zh: 输入网址后，这里会显示规范化结果与发现的问题。

wallet_deferredScreensPayWhyNoticeBody.en: Payments involve compliance and payment provider approval and need a separate review. Community, Mining and Launch come first.
wallet_deferredScreensPayWhyNoticeBody.zh: 支付涉及合规与支付商准入，需要独立评估。先把社区、挖矿与 Launch 的闭环跑通。

wallet_homeLoopNetWorthChangeAvailable.en: Calculated from the same price read
wallet_homeLoopNetWorthChangeAvailable.zh: 按同一次价格读取计算

wallet_homeLoopNetWorthChangeUnavailable.en: Some assets have no 24h price change, so it's hidden for now
wallet_homeLoopNetWorthChangeUnavailable.zh: 部分资产没有 24h 价格变化，暂不显示

wallet_homeShowWalletPowerSheet.en: Registered assets in your wallet earn mining power by their weights, and power decides how much LOOP you get each day. Community tokens count only after you join an approved linked community. See each asset's weight and power on the Mining page.
wallet_homeShowWalletPowerSheet.zh: 钱包里已登记的资产会按各自的权重产生挖矿算力，算力决定每天能分到的 LOOP。社区币须加入已通过审核的绑定社区才计入。每个资产的权重与算力在挖矿页查看。

wallet_homeShowWalletTotalInfoSheet.en: Total assets is the value of registered assets at current prices, for display only; it isn't an available balance. The usable amount is the "Usable" figure on each asset page.
wallet_homeShowWalletTotalInfoSheet.zh: 总资产是按当前价格对已登记资产的估值，只用于展示，不是可用余额。能动用的数量以每个资产页的「可动用」为准。

wallet_homeValue.en: {unavailableCount, plural, =1{1 asset has no price yet} other{{unavailableCount} assets have no price yet}}

wallet_homeWalletPowerTagLabel.zh: 持仓产生算力，查看说明

wallet_homeWalletRowChangeUsd.en: {count, plural, =1{1 asset has no price yet, not included} other{{count} assets have no price yet, not included}}
wallet_homeWalletRowChangeUsd.zh: {count} 项资产暂无价格，未计入

wallet_miningHooksWalletPowerHintText.zh: 钱包持仓正在产生算力

wallet_miningHooksWalletPowerHintText2.en: Wallet holdings earn power by weight
wallet_miningHooksWalletPowerHintText2.zh: 钱包持仓按权重产生算力

wallet_moneyActionsAssetBlocked.en: This asset is blocked; no fund actions are allowed.
wallet_moneyActionsAssetBlocked.zh: 这个资产已被屏蔽，不能进行任何资金操作。

wallet_moneyActionsAssetNotInAllowlist.en: This asset isn't in the current range of supported assets, so this action didn't pass. LOOP maintains the range and it can't be changed in the app; use an asset within the range.
wallet_moneyActionsAssetNotInAllowlist.zh: 这个资产不在当前可操作的资产范围里，这笔操作没有通过。范围由 LOOP 维护，不能在应用里调整；请换一个在范围内的资产。

wallet_moneyActionsBuild3.en: No fresh market data this time, so no value is shown.
wallet_moneyActionsBuild3.zh: 本次没有可用的新鲜行情，因此不展示估值。

wallet_moneyActionsCanaryCeilingExceeded.en: {figures}This action exceeds the per-transaction limit. No transaction was submitted. LOOP sets the limit; lower the amount and try again.
wallet_moneyActionsCanaryCeilingExceeded.zh: {figures}这笔操作超过了单笔金额上限，没有提交任何交易。上限由 LOOP 设定，请降低本次金额后再试。

wallet_moneyActionsCanaryDailyCeilingExc.en: {figures}{budget}This action would exceed the 24-hour cumulative limit. No transaction was submitted. LOOP sets the limit; lower the amount, or wait until the 24-hour window rolls over.
wallet_moneyActionsCanaryDailyCeilingExc.zh: {figures}{budget}这笔操作会超过 24 小时内的累计金额上限，没有提交任何交易。上限由 LOOP 设定，请降低金额，或等累计额度滚过这 24 小时。

wallet_moneyActionsCounterpartyNotInAllo.en: This recipient address isn't on the current allowed list, so this action didn't pass and no transaction was submitted. LOOP maintains the list and it can't be changed in the app; use an address on the list.
wallet_moneyActionsCounterpartyNotInAllo.zh: 这个收款地址不在当前允许的收款名单里，这笔操作没有通过，也没有提交任何交易。名单由 LOOP 维护，不能在应用里调整；请换一个名单内的地址。

wallet_moneyActionsNativeAssetNotApprova.en: Native BNB has no approvals: it isn't ERC-20 and has no allowance to approve or revoke. This step doesn't apply to native assets.
wallet_moneyActionsNativeAssetNotApprova.zh: 原生 BNB 没有授权面：它不是 ERC-20，没有 allowance 可以授权或回收。这一步不适用于原生资产。

wallet_moneyActionsPriceImpactBlocked.en: The price impact of this swap is too high, so it was blocked. Lower the amount or try again later.
wallet_moneyActionsPriceImpactBlocked.zh: 这笔兑换的价格影响过大，已被阻止。请减小金额或稍后再试。

wallet_moneyActionsPurpose.en: This step requires two-step verification, which isn't available yet. Nothing was signed, broadcast or submitted. Check the verification methods available in Security Center.
wallet_moneyActionsPurpose.zh: 这一步需要二次验证，二次验证还没有开放，没有签名、没有广播，也没有提交任何交易。请到安全中心查看当前可用的验证方式。

wallet_moneyActionsReason.en: Submitted, waiting for the on-chain receipt. A success message doesn't mean it's done on-chain.
wallet_moneyActionsReason.zh: 已提交，等待链上回执。成功提示不代表链上已完成。

wallet_moneyActionsReason2.en: This action was submitted and the result is unknown, so it's locked. Check the result page; don't submit again.
wallet_moneyActionsReason2.zh: 这笔操作已提交且结果未知，已锁定。请在结果页查看，不要重复提交。

wallet_moneyActionsS.en: The wallet broadcast it ({txHash}), but this report wasn't accepted. The transaction may already be on-chain. Check the result page and report again later; don't sign again.
wallet_moneyActionsS.zh: 钱包已经广播（{txHash}），但这次上报没有被接受。这笔交易可能已经上链，请在结果页查看并稍后重新上报，不要重复签名。

wallet_moneyActionsSetState.en: The wallet signed, but this submission hasn't been recorded yet. Check the status on the result page; don't sign again.
wallet_moneyActionsSetState.zh: 钱包已经签名，但这次提交还没有记录到。请到结果页查看状态，不要重复签名。

wallet_moneyActionsSetState2.en: The wallet didn't finish signing. No transaction was submitted.
wallet_moneyActionsSetState2.zh: 钱包没有完成签名，没有提交任何交易。

wallet_moneyActionsSwitch.en: The current policy doesn't allow this action. No transaction was submitted. We won't guess which rule applies.
wallet_moneyActionsSwitch.zh: 当前策略不允许这笔操作，没有提交任何交易。这里不猜是哪一条。

wallet_moneyActionsTitle.en: This step requires two-step verification; no transaction was submitted
wallet_moneyActionsTitle.zh: 这一步需要二次验证，没有提交任何交易

wallet_moneyActionsTitle2.en: This action isn't available in your region; no transaction was submitted
wallet_moneyActionsTitle2.zh: 当前地区不能执行此操作，没有提交任何交易

wallet_moneyActionsTitle4.en: Rejected by policy; no transaction was submitted
wallet_moneyActionsTitle4.zh: 被策略拒绝，没有提交任何交易

wallet_moneyActionsUnlimitedExposureExce.en: {figures}An unlimited approval's exposure is based on the current balance and exceeds the per-transaction limit. Use a limited approval, or lower this asset's balance first.
wallet_moneyActionsUnlimitedExposureExce.zh: {figures}无限授权按当前余额计算敞口，已超过单笔上限。请改用限额授权，或先降低这个资产的余额。

wallet_moneyAssetPickerSummary.zh: 余额为 0 的资产 · {folded} 个

wallet_moneyAssetPickerTitle2.en: This wallet has no readable assets yet
wallet_moneyAssetPickerTitle2.zh: 这个钱包还没有可读资产

wallet_moneyAssetPickerTitle4.en: No assets with a usable balance
wallet_moneyAssetPickerTitle4.zh: 没有可动用余额的资产

wallet_networthDetail.en: The trend is the USD value the server records hourly for this wallet, for display only; it isn't an available balance.
wallet_networthDetail.zh: 走势是服务端每小时为这个钱包记下的 USD 估值，只用于展示，不是可用余额。

wallet_networthIf.en: CNY converted at {walletFxSourceLabel} 1 USD = {rate} CNY (published {published}, observed {observed}){stale}
wallet_networthIf.zh: 人民币按{walletFxSourceLabel} 1 USD = {rate} CNY（{published} 发布，观察于 {observed}）折算{stale}

wallet_networthWalletNetworthChartEmptyM.en: No net value records in this range yet · recorded hourly; the line starts once you have assets
wallet_networthWalletNetworthChartEmptyM.zh: 这个区间还没有净值记录 · 每小时记一次，有资产后开始画线

wallet_networthWalletNetworthChartUnavai.en: Net value trend can't be loaded right now

wallet_nftSendContractUnsupported.en: Sending this NFT isn't supported yet
wallet_nftSendContractUnsupported.zh: 暂不支持发送这个 NFT

wallet_nftSendIdempotencyConflict.en: This send was already submitted. Check the latest status
wallet_nftSendIdempotencyConflict.zh: 这笔发送已提交过，请查看最新状态

wallet_nftSendInsufficientBalance.en: Not enough {loopLaunchNativeSymbolText} for fees. Top up and try again
wallet_nftSendInsufficientBalance.zh: {loopLaunchNativeSymbolText} 手续费不足，充值后再试

wallet_nftSendNotOwned.en: This NFT is no longer in your wallet. Go back and choose again
wallet_nftSendNotOwned.zh: 这枚 NFT 已不在钱包，请返回重新选择

wallet_nftSendRecipientRejects.en: The recipient address doesn't accept this NFT
wallet_nftSendRecipientRejects.zh: 收款地址不接收这枚 NFT

wallet_nftSendSimulationFailed.en: This send didn't pass simulation. Try again later
wallet_nftSendSimulationFailed.zh: 这笔发送预执行没有通过，请稍后再试

wallet_readCreating.en: Requesting an embedded wallet from Privy; the list refreshes automatically when done.
wallet_readCreating.zh: 正在向 Privy 申请嵌入式钱包，完成后清单会自动刷新。

wallet_readFailed.en: The last creation didn't finish: {provisioning} Your sign-in is unchanged; you can try again.
wallet_readFailed.zh: 上一次创建没有完成：{provisioning} 登录状态没有变化，可以再试一次。

wallet_readIf.en: Only the sum of valued assets, not total assets
wallet_readIf.zh: 只是已估值资产的合计，不是总资产

wallet_readMessage.en: Development preview doesn't create a real wallet or call Privy.
wallet_readMessage.zh: 开发预览不会创建真实钱包，也不会调用 Privy。

wallet_readMessage2.en: This session isn't verified, so a wallet can't be created right now. Sign in again and retry.
wallet_readMessage2.zh: 当前会话未完成验证，暂时不能创建钱包。重新登录后可以再试。

wallet_readModelsSwitch.en: Only receives assets on the BNB Smart Chain (BSC) network. Assets sent to this address from other networks may be lost permanently.
wallet_readModelsSwitch.zh: 只接收 BNB Smart Chain（BSC）网络的资产。把其他网络的资产发到这个地址可能永久丢失。

wallet_readModelsSwitch2.en: Make sure the sender's network matches the one shown here.
wallet_readModelsSwitch2.zh: 请先确认发送方使用的网络与这里显示的一致。

wallet_readScreensBalancesFailureLine.en: This account doesn't have permission to read balances
wallet_readScreensBalancesFailureLine.zh: 当前账号没有权限读取余额

wallet_readScreensEmptyMessage.en: The wallet list hasn't loaded yet

wallet_readScreensEmptyMessage2.en: This wallet doesn't have this row

wallet_readScreensEmptyMessage3.en: No transfers for this asset yet
wallet_readScreensEmptyMessage3.zh: 这个资产还没有收发记录

wallet_readScreensEmptyMessage6.zh: 没有已连接的外部钱包

wallet_readScreensEmptyReason.en: This isn't "no wallet"; the list just wasn't loaded this time.
wallet_readScreensEmptyReason.zh: 这不是“没有钱包”，只是这次没有读到清单。

wallet_readScreensEmptyReason2.en: The indexer has read this range, but it has no transfers for this wallet.
wallet_readScreensEmptyReason2.zh: 索引器已经读到这个区间，但其中没有属于这个钱包的转账。

wallet_readScreensIf2.en: Name and decimals come only from on-chain calls
wallet_readScreensIf2.zh: 名称与精度只来自链上调用

wallet_readScreensLabel10.zh: 最小单位余额（{decimals} 位精度的整数）

wallet_readScreensLabel14.zh: 原生 BNB 转账不可用

wallet_readScreensLabel15.en: Bridge and mining claim history unavailable
wallet_readScreensLabel15.zh: 跨链与挖矿领取记录不可用

wallet_readScreensLabel16.en: MEME records not available right now

wallet_readScreensLabel6.zh: 可动用（扣除手续费保留）

wallet_readScreensLabel7.zh: 待确认入账（不计入可用）

wallet_readScreensLoopBadge.en: Data may be out of date

wallet_readScreensLoopProvenanceFooter.en: Holdings in all linked wallets count toward power, no need to move them. LOOP ID is your identity; wallets are replaceable credentials and addresses aren't account identifiers.
wallet_readScreensLoopProvenanceFooter.zh: 所有绑定钱包的持仓都计入算力，不用搬家。LOOP ID 是你的身份，钱包只是可更换的凭证，地址不是账号标识。

wallet_readScreensLoopSheetHeading.zh: 最多绑定 {limit} 个外部钱包

wallet_readScreensMeTradesCapabilityBloc.en: Wallet activity isn't available right now

wallet_readScreensMessage.en: This device can't open the share sheet. Copy the address instead
wallet_readScreensMessage.zh: 这台设备打不开分享面板，请改用复制地址

wallet_readScreensMessage12.en: Records haven't loaded yet; there's nothing to export.
wallet_readScreensMessage12.zh: 记录还没有读到，没有可以导出的内容。

wallet_readScreensMessage2.en: The wallet list isn't available right now, so external wallets can't be connected.
wallet_readScreensMessage2.zh: 钱包清单当前不可用，暂时不能连接外部钱包。

wallet_readScreensMessage3.en: The wallet list hasn't loaded yet. Connect an external wallet once it loads.
wallet_readScreensMessage3.zh: 钱包清单还没有读到，读到之后再连接外部钱包。

wallet_readScreensMessage4.zh: 钱包绑定没有完成，请重试。

wallet_readScreensMessage5.en: You've reached the limit of {limit} external wallets. Unlink one first
wallet_readScreensMessage5.zh: 已达 {limit} 个外部钱包上限，请先解绑一个

wallet_readScreensMessage6.en: External wallet linked; the wallet list will refresh shortly
wallet_readScreensMessage6.zh: 外部钱包已绑定，钱包清单稍后刷新

wallet_readScreensMessage8.en: Unlinking didn't finish. Try again later.
wallet_readScreensMessage8.zh: 解绑没有完成，请稍后重试。

wallet_readScreensMessage9.en: External wallet unlinked; the wallet list will refresh shortly
wallet_readScreensMessage9.zh: 已解绑外部钱包，钱包清单稍后刷新

wallet_readScreensNetworksCapabilityBloc.en: On-chain reads aren't available right now

wallet_readScreensNetworksChainMismatchL.en: The endpoint didn't return BNB Smart Chain
wallet_readScreensNetworksChainMismatchL.zh: 端点返回的不是 BNB Smart Chain

wallet_readScreensNetworksChainParameter.zh: {status}{chainId} · {groupedFigure} 确认 · 重组跟踪 {groupedFigure2} 块

wallet_readScreensNetworksLaunchChainRow.zh: {chainId} · {groupedFigure} 确认 · 重组跟踪 {groupedFigure2} 块

wallet_readScreensNetworksNoEndpointsLab.zh: 没有已配置的 RPC 端点

wallet_readScreensNetworksRegistryText.zh: 可读资产 {readableAssetCount} 个 · 已登记池 {registeredPoolCount} 个

wallet_readScreensOffline.zh: 网络已断开，余额没有读到

wallet_readScreensOpenExternalWallet.en: Wallet {truncatedAddress} becomes the current wallet for balances, activity and Receive.
wallet_readScreensOpenExternalWallet.zh: 钱包 {truncatedAddress} 会成为余额、活动与收款页的当前钱包。

wallet_readScreensRateLimited.en: Too many requests. Try again later
wallet_readScreensRateLimited.zh: 请求过于频繁，稍后再试

wallet_readScreensReceiveNoNetworkDetail.en: Receivable networks can't be loaded right now.
wallet_readScreensReceiveNoNetworkDetail.zh: 暂时读不到可接收的网络。

wallet_readScreensReceiveWarningTitle.en: Only receive assets on this network
wallet_readScreensReceiveWarningTitle.zh: 只接收这一条网络的资产

wallet_readScreensSX.en: Launch chain balances are read from block {groupedFigure} and aren't included in total assets.
wallet_readScreensSX.zh: Launch 链余额读自区块 {groupedFigure}，不计入总资产。

wallet_readScreensSwitch.en: Balance can't be loaded right now

wallet_readScreensTimedOut.en: Read timed out; balance not loaded
wallet_readScreensTimedOut.zh: 读取超时，余额没有读到

wallet_readScreensTxEntrySheetExplorerNo.en: LOOP can't open an external browser directly yet. Copy the link and open it in a browser to see the same transaction on-chain.
wallet_readScreensTxEntrySheetExplorerNo.zh: LOOP 目前不能直接唤起外部浏览器。复制链接后在浏览器里打开，看到的是链上的同一笔。

wallet_readScreensTxEntrySheetExplorerNo.en: Paste it into a browser yourself
wallet_readScreensTxEntrySheetExplorerNo.zh: 在浏览器里打开要自己粘贴

wallet_readScreensUnavailable.en: On-chain balance can't be loaded right now

wallet_readScreensWalletAssetActivityEmp.en: The indexer has read this range, but it has no transfers for this asset.
wallet_readScreensWalletAssetActivityEmp.zh: 索引器已经读到这个区间，但其中没有属于这个资产的转账。

wallet_readScreensWalletAssetCrosscheckB.en: The on-chain reading doesn't match the value reported by Privy{crossCheck}. This page always shows the on-chain reading; the cross-check doesn't change it.
wallet_readScreensWalletAssetCrosscheckB.zh: 链上读数与 Privy 报告的数值不一致{crossCheck}。这里显示的始终是链上读数，交叉核对不会改变它。

wallet_readScreensWalletAssetCrosscheckU.zh: 与 Privy 的交叉核对不可用

wallet_readScreensWalletAssetHistoryEntr.en: All ERC-20 transfers for this wallet, from the on-chain index
wallet_readScreensWalletAssetHistoryEntr.zh: 这个钱包的全部 ERC-20 转账，来自链上索引

wallet_readScreensWalletAssetInvalidIden.en: This page only accepts a canonical CAIP assetId; no balance was requested.
wallet_readScreensWalletAssetInvalidIden.zh: 本页只接受规范的 CAIP assetId，未请求任何余额。

wallet_readScreensWalletAssetInvalidIden.en: No usable asset ID in the route
wallet_readScreensWalletAssetInvalidIden.zh: 路由中没有可用的资产标识

wallet_readScreensWalletAssetMissingRowD.en: Only registered assets show a balance.
wallet_readScreensWalletAssetMissingRowD.zh: 只有已登记的资产才会显示余额。

wallet_readScreensWalletAssetMissingRowM.en: This asset isn't on the readable list
wallet_readScreensWalletAssetMissingRowM.zh: 这个资产不在可读清单里

wallet_readScreensWalletCapabilityBlockT.en: Wallet reads aren't available right now

wallet_readScreensWalletNftUnavailableMe.en: MEME v2 isn't available yet, so project NFTs can't be loaded right now
wallet_readScreensWalletNftUnavailableMe.zh: MEME v2 暂未开放，项目 NFT 暂时读不到

wallet_readScreensWalletSnapshotFooterDe.en: Every balance row is read from the same block ({groupedFigure} confirmations). Native BNB keeps {formatDecimal} BNB as a fee reserve, not included in usable. {launchSnapshot}

launchSnapshot.example: launchSnapshot == null ? '' : 'Launch 链余额读自区块 ${loopGroupedFigure(launchSnapshot.blockNumber.toString())}，不计入总资产。'

wallet_readScreensWalletSnapshotFooterDe.zh: 每一行余额都读自同一个区块（{groupedFigure} 确认）。原生 BNB 会保留 {formatDecimal} BNB 作为手续费，不计入可动用。{launchSnapshot}

wallet_readScreensWalletsAddSheetNetwork.en: Networks in mainland China need a VPN to connect external wallets.
wallet_readScreensWalletsAddSheetNetwork.zh: 大陆网络需要开 VPN 才能连接外部钱包。

wallet_readScreensWalletsAddSheetNetwork.en: Mainland China networks need a VPN

wallet_readScreensWalletsAddSheetReasonB.en: External wallets are only used to calculate power; you can't trade or claim rewards with them in LOOP. LOOP never gets your private key.
wallet_readScreensWalletsAddSheetReasonB.zh: 外部钱包只用于计算算力，不能在 LOOP 内交易或领奖励；LOOP 不会获取你的私钥。

wallet_readScreensWalletsAddSheetReasonT.en: External wallets only count toward power
wallet_readScreensWalletsAddSheetReasonT.zh: 外部钱包只用于计算算力

wallet_readScreensWalletsAddSheetScopeBo.en: Community tokens in every linked wallet count toward power; no need to move assets into one wallet.
wallet_readScreensWalletsAddSheetScopeBo.zh: 已绑定钱包里的社区币都会计入算力，不用把资产搬到某一个钱包。

wallet_readScreensWalletsAddSheetScopeTi.en: Holdings in all linked wallets count toward power
wallet_readScreensWalletsAddSheetScopeTi.zh: 所有绑定钱包的持仓都计入算力

wallet_readScreensWalletsCapabilityBlock.en: The wallet list isn't available right now

wallet_readScreensWalletsLimitSheetBody.en: You can link up to {limit} external wallets. Unlink one before connecting a new wallet.
wallet_readScreensWalletsLimitSheetBody.zh: 最多绑定 {limit} 个外部钱包，请先解绑一个，再连接新的钱包。

wallet_readScreensWalletsUnlinkSheetBody.en: After unlinking, this wallet's holdings stop counting toward power from the next hour. Assets in wallet {truncatedAddress} aren't affected, and you can link it again later.
wallet_readScreensWalletsUnlinkSheetBody.zh: 解绑后这个钱包的持仓从下一小时起不再计入算力。钱包 {truncatedAddress} 里的资产不受影响，之后也可以重新绑定。

wallet_readSemanticLabel.en: Usable, power and fee reserve for {symbol}
wallet_readSemanticLabel.zh: {symbol} 的可动用、算力与手续费保留

wallet_readSwitch2.en: LOOP will create a Privy embedded wallet for this account. The address is a public on-chain fact, not an account identifier.
wallet_readSwitch2.zh: LOOP 会为这个账号创建一个 Privy 嵌入式钱包。地址是公开的链上事实，不是账号标识。

wallet_readTitle.en: This account has no wallet yet

wallet_readWalletNetworthPartial.zh: 部分估值 · {unavailableCount} 项无价格

wallet_readWalletSnapshotFooterText.zh: 区块 {groupedFigure} · {groupedFigure2} 确认 · 观察于 {relativeTime}

wallet_sendScreensBody.en: {moneyActionTitle} · {moneyIntentStateLabel}. Preparing a new one will invalidate it; if it's already signed and broadcast, report or cancel it first.
wallet_sendScreensBody.zh: {moneyActionTitle} · {moneyIntentStateLabel}。再准备一笔新的会让它失效；如果它已经签名并广播，请先上报或取消。

wallet_sendScreensBuild6.en: These two rows are what you entered in the previous step, not server facts yet. Network fee, balance and simulation appear together once this transfer is prepared.
wallet_sendScreensBuild6.zh: 这两行是你在上一步填的内容，还不是服务端的事实。网络费、余额与试算会在准备好这一笔之后一起显示。

wallet_sendScreensBuild7.en: There's no source for arrival time, so no made-up seconds here. After submitting, track it by confirmations on the result page; that's the only progress.
wallet_sendScreensBuild7.zh: 没有到账时间的来源，这里不给一个编出来的秒数。提交之后在结果页按确认数跟踪，那是唯一的进度。

wallet_sendScreensEmptyMessage.en: This account has no wallet that can send yet
wallet_sendScreensEmptyMessage.zh: 这个账号还没有可用于发送的钱包

wallet_sendScreensEmptyReason.en: Only the Privy embedded wallet can sign and broadcast from this device.
wallet_sendScreensEmptyReason.zh: 只有 Privy 嵌入式钱包可以从本机签名并广播。

wallet_sendScreensLoopBalanceAvailable.zh: 可动用 {formatDecimal} {symbol}（已扣除手续费保留）

wallet_sendScreensMissing.en: One more step: waiting for address check.
wallet_sendScreensMissing.zh: 还差一步：等待地址校验。

wallet_sendScreensRecipientStep3.en: Invalid address format: starts with 0x, 42 characters
wallet_sendScreensRecipientStep3.zh: 地址格式不对：0x 开头，共 42 位

wallet_sendScreensSendAddressNextMissing.en: One more step: enter the full recipient address (starts with 0x, 42 characters).
wallet_sendScreensSendAddressNextMissing.zh: 还差一步：填写完整的收款地址（0x 开头，42 位）。

wallet_sendScreensSendAmountNextMissing.en: One more step: choose the asset to send.
wallet_sendScreensSendAmountNextMissing.zh: 还差一步：选择要发送的资产。

wallet_sendScreensSendAmountNextMissing2.en: One more step: enter the amount to send.
wallet_sendScreensSendAmountNextMissing2.zh: 还差一步：填写发送数量。

wallet_sendScreensSendAmountNextMissing3.en: The amount exceeds your usable balance. Lower it.
wallet_sendScreensSendAmountNextMissing3.zh: 发送数量超过了可动用余额，请改小。

wallet_sendScreensSendAssetSelectorSubti.en: {candidates, plural, =1{1 asset can be sent} other{{candidates} assets can be sent}}

wallet_sendScreensSendAssetsEmptyMessage.en: Once assets are registered, each one always keeps a row here.
wallet_sendScreensSendAssetsEmptyMessage.zh: 登记资产后，这里会为每一个资产恒定保留一行。

wallet_sendScreensSendConfirmExpiredBody.zh: 请重新准备一次再签名。

wallet_sendScreensSendConfirmExpiredBody.en: Balance, fees and simulation all come from the same moment. Prepare it again before signing.
wallet_sendScreensSendConfirmExpiredBody.zh: 余额、费用与试算结果都取自同一时刻。请重新准备一次再签名。

wallet_sendScreensSendConfirmPowerBody.en: Power drops with your holdings after sending. The exact figure can't be loaded right now, so no estimate is made here.
wallet_sendScreensSendConfirmPowerBody.zh: 转出后算力会随持仓下降。具体数值暂时读不到，这里不做估算。

wallet_sendScreensSendConfirmSigningExit.en: Signing is done on this device by the Privy embedded wallet; every fund action goes through the same signing sheet, the only signing exit in the product.
wallet_sendScreensSendConfirmSigningExit.zh: 签名由 Privy 嵌入式钱包在本机执行；所有资金操作都汇聚到同一个签名弹层，这是全产品唯一的签名出口。

wallet_sendScreensSendConfirmSimulationF.zh: 试算没有通过，不能签名

wallet_sendScreensSendPowerNoticeBody.en: After sending a weighted community token, power drops with your holdings. The exact figure can't be loaded right now, so no estimate is made here.
wallet_sendScreensSendPowerNoticeBody.zh: 转出有权重的社区币后，算力会随持仓下降。具体数值暂时读不到，这里不做估算。

wallet_sendScreensSendRecipientBasisText.en: First-time recipient is judged by your own ERC-20 transfer history indexed in LOOP
wallet_sendScreensSendRecipientBasisText.zh: 首次收款方的判断依据：你自己在 LOOP 已索引的 ERC-20 转账记录

wallet_sendScreensSendRecipientChecksSum.zh: 地址核对 · {headlines} 项待确认 · {first}

wallet_sendScreensSendRecipientContractB.en: Sending directly to a contract address may lose this asset permanently. Make sure this contract actually accepts direct transfers.
wallet_sendScreensSendRecipientContractB.zh: 向合约地址直接转账可能永久失去这笔资产。请确认这个合约确实接受直接转账。

wallet_sendScreensSendRecipientFirstTime.en: This address isn't in your own indexed transfer history. Check the full address character by character before continuing.
wallet_sendScreensSendRecipientFirstTime.zh: 这个地址不在你自己的已索引转账历史中。请逐字核对完整地址后再继续。

wallet_sendScreensSendRecipientPrefill.en: Recipient address from scan, checked automatically
wallet_sendScreensSendRecipientPrefill.zh: 收款地址来自扫码，已自动校验

wallet_sendScreensTitle.en: This wallet has an unfinished action
wallet_sendScreensTitle.zh: 这个钱包还有一笔未完成的操作

wallet_swapScreensBalanceLineFor.en: Choose the asset to pay with first; its usable balance shows here.
wallet_swapScreensBalanceLineFor.zh: 先选择要支付的资产，这里会显示它的可动用余额。

wallet_swapScreensBalanceLineFor3.en: This wallet doesn't have this row, so its balance can't be read.
wallet_swapScreensBalanceLineFor3.zh: 这个钱包没有这一行，读不到它的余额。

wallet_swapScreensEmptyMessage.en: This account has no wallet that can swap yet
wallet_swapScreensEmptyMessage.zh: 这个账号还没有可兑换的钱包

wallet_swapScreensLoopProvenanceFooter.en: Only the final quote is shown: per-hop details appear only when the quote provider supplies a path, and it didn't this time.
wallet_swapScreensLoopProvenanceFooter.zh: 只展示最终报价：只有报价方提供路径时才会显示逐跳明细，这次没有提供。

wallet_swapScreensSwapConfirmActionLabel.zh: 报价已过期 · 重新报价

wallet_swapScreensSwapImpactBlockedTitle.en: Price impact exceeds the hard block line
wallet_swapScreensSwapImpactBlockedTitle.zh: 价格影响超过硬阻断线

wallet_swapScreensSwapImpactConfirmBody.en: This swap will noticeably move the price. Slippage and price impact are different: slippage is the limit you set, price impact is the shift this trade itself causes.
wallet_swapScreensSwapImpactConfirmBody.zh: 这笔兑换会明显推动价格。滑点与价格影响是两件事：滑点是你设定的上限，价格影响是这笔成交本身造成的偏移。

wallet_swapScreensSwapPowerNoticeBody.en: The power change after buying can't be loaded right now, so no estimate is made here.
wallet_swapScreensSwapPowerNoticeBody.zh: 买入后的算力变化暂时读不到，这里不做估算。

wallet_swapScreensSwapQuoteActionLabel2.en: Choose assets to pay and receive
wallet_swapScreensSwapQuoteActionLabel2.zh: 选择支付与获得的资产

wallet_swapScreensSwapQuoteActionLabel3.en: Enter an amount to get a quote

wallet_swapScreensSwapRouteProvenanceTex.en: Quoted by {provider} · pricing source {priceImpact} · valid for {quoteTtlSeconds}s
wallet_swapScreensSwapRouteProvenanceTex.zh: 报价方 {provider} · 定价出处 {priceImpact} · 有效期 {quoteTtlSeconds} 秒

wallet_swapScreensSwapRoutingNoticeBody.en: LOOP doesn't build its own routes or split hops. Only the final quote returned by Privy is shown here; swapped assets go straight into this wallet.
wallet_swapScreensSwapRoutingNoticeBody.zh: LOOP 不自建路由，也不做逐跳拆解。这里只展示 Privy 返回的最终报价；兑换所得资产直接进入本钱包。

wallet_swapScreensText.en: I understand the price impact is between 1% and 5% and want to continue
wallet_swapScreensText.zh: 我已知晓价格影响在 1%–5% 之间，仍要继续

wallet_txResultEmptyMessage.en: This action has no readable status
wallet_txResultEmptyMessage.zh: 这笔操作没有可读状态

wallet_txResultIf.en: Result, transaction hash and next steps are all here; no new quotes are mixed in.
wallet_txResultIf.zh: 结果、交易哈希和下一步动作集中在这里，不会混入新的报价。

receipt.example: receipt.confirmations == null ? '确认数读不到' : '${loopGroupedFigure(receipt.confirmations.toString())} 确认'

wallet_txResultTxResultCapabilityBlockTi.en: Transaction status can't be read right now

wallet_txResultTxResultEmptyMessage.en: When you come here from a Send, approval or Swap signing page, this page shows that transaction's status.
wallet_txResultTxResultEmptyMessage.zh: 从发送、授权或兑换的签名页进来时，这一页会显示那一笔的状态。

wallet_txResultTxResultEmptyTitle.en: No action to show here yet
wallet_txResultTxResultEmptyTitle.zh: 这里还没有要展示的操作

wallet_txResultTxResultFolioCaption.en: The result page shows one specific action and needs to know which one.
wallet_txResultTxResultFolioCaption.zh: 结果页只展示一笔具体操作，需要指定是哪一笔。

wallet_txResultTxResultFolioCaption2.en: The result follows the on-chain check; this page doesn't decide success on its own.
wallet_txResultTxResultFolioCaption2.zh: 结果以链上核对为准，这一页不会自己判断成败。

wallet_txResultTxResultPendingBody.en: A successful submission doesn't mean it's done on-chain; it still needs 15 block confirmations.
wallet_txResultTxResultPendingBody.zh: 提交成功不代表链上已完成，还需要 15 个区块确认。

wallet_txResultTxResultPollingStoppedBod.en: {maximumPollFailures} reads failed in a row, so this page has stopped retrying automatically. This action's status hasn't changed; retry manually.
wallet_txResultTxResultPollingStoppedBod.zh: 连续 {maximumPollFailures} 次读取失败，本页不再自动重试，已停止自动重试。这笔操作的状态没有改变，请手动重试。

wallet_txResultTxResultUnknownLockBody.en: {reasonCodeText} This page will only keep checking and won't submit again; don't sign again.
wallet_txResultTxResultUnknownLockBody.zh: {reasonCodeText} 本页只会继续查询，不会重复提交；请勿再次签名。

wallet_txResultTxResultUnreportedBody.en: If the wallet already broadcast this transaction, it may be on-chain and only the report failed. Come back and retry later; don't sign again until the submission is accepted.
wallet_txResultTxResultUnreportedBody.zh: 如果钱包已经广播过这笔交易，它可能已经上链，只是上报没有成功。请稍后回到这里重试，在提交被接受之前不要重新签名。

wallet_txResultTxResultUnreportedTitle.en: This submission hasn't been recorded yet
wallet_txResultTxResultUnreportedTitle.zh: 这次提交还没有记录到

wallet_swapMainnetOnly.en: Swap supports BNB Chain mainnet assets only.
wallet_swapMainnetOnly.zh: 兑换只支持 BSC 主网资产。
